# Error codes

## Exit codes

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `success` | Success. |
| 1 | `failure` | The command ran but reported failure (agent error, failing eval tasks, doctor failures). |
| 2 | `usage` | Usage error (unknown command, flag or argument). |
| 3 | `budget_exhausted` | Budget exhausted. |
| 4 | `approval_required` | Approval or confirmation required but unobtainable non-interactively. |
| 5 | `partial` | Partial result (some items skipped or ungraded). |
| 10 | `update_available` | Update available (`prometheus update --check` only). |
| 65 | `invalid_input` | Invalid input data (for example harness tree validation). |
| 66 | `not_found` | Not found. |
| 69 | `unavailable` | Unavailable (provider, daemon, runtime, surface missing, or self-update of an install owned elsewhere). |
| 70 | `internal` | Internal error. |
| 73 | `cannot_create_output` | Cannot create output. |
| 74 | `io` | I/O error. |
| 75 | `temporary_failure` | Temporary failure or lock held (retryable). |
| 76 | `protocol_mismatch` | Protocol mismatch. |
| 77 | `permission_denied` | Permission denied or strict security posture failure. |
| 78 | `config` | Configuration or credential error. |
| 130 | `interrupted` | Interrupted by SIGINT. |
| 143 | `terminated` | Terminated by SIGTERM. |
